arguments.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies user requirements: price $69 (within $100 max), quality score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum). Evidence: independent_outdoor_lab certificate CERT-7318 (verified, quality_score 4.8) confirms 72-hour 45 mph wind tunnel testing, 3000 mm hydrostatic head, 200-cycle pole fatigue, and 150D floor abrasion rating—directly supporting durability mandate for a 4-person tent. TENT-284 rejected: certificate CERT-4107 has scope-limited coverage (2P frame only, not the 4P variant sold), making its certificate unsuitable despite lower price.
